setting GroupSetting(A nonempty_set, mul fn(x, y A) A, one A, inv fn(x A) A):
    forall u, v, w A:
        mul(mul(u, v), w) = mul(u, mul(v, w))
    forall u A:
        mul(one, u) = u
        mul(u, one) = u
        mul(inv(u), u) = one
        mul(u, inv(u)) = one
blocks.reusable_lesson: Named settings carry the group laws into theorem contexts.

thm group_left_cancel:
    ? forall [GroupSetting], a, b, c A:
        mul(a, b) = mul(a, c)
        =>:
            b = c
    mul(inv(a), a) = one
    b = mul(one, b) = mul(mul(inv(a), a), b) = mul(inv(a), mul(a, b)) = mul(inv(a), mul(a, c)) = mul(mul(inv(a), a), c) = mul(one, c) = c
blocks.reusable_lesson: Cancellation provides the exact identity-preservation conclusion later selected by by thm.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm group_identity_unique:
    ? forall [GroupSetting], identity A:
        forall a A:
            mul(identity, a) = a
            mul(a, identity) = a
        =>:
            identity = one
    identity = mul(one, identity) = one
blocks.reusable_lesson: Identity uniqueness stays unchanged by the proof-call readability migration.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm group_inverse_unique:
    ? forall [GroupSetting], a, b A:
        mul(b, a) = one
        =>:
            b = inv(a)
    mul(a, inv(a)) = one
    b = mul(b, one) = mul(b, mul(a, inv(a))) = mul(mul(b, a), inv(a)) = mul(one, inv(a)) = inv(a)
blocks.reusable_lesson: The selected-fact form may choose the symmetric equality inferred from this theorem result.

thm homomorphism_maps_identity:
    ? forall [GroupHomomorphismSetting]:
        f(one_A) = one_B
    mul_A(one_A, one_A) = one_A

thm homomorphism_maps_inverse:
    ? forall [GroupHomomorphismSetting], a A:
        f(inv_A(a)) = inv_B(f(a))
    by thm homomorphism_maps_identity(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f) => f(one_A) = one_B
    mul_A(inv_A(a), a) = one_A
    mul_B(f(inv_A(a)), f(a)) = f(mul_A(inv_A(a), a)) = f(one_A) = one_B
    by thm group_inverse_unique(B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f(a), f(inv_A(a))) => f(inv_A(a)) = inv_B(f(a))
blocks.reusable_lesson: An arrow makes each theorem application's local dataflow visible and limits its stored result.

thm kernel_is_normal_subgroup:
    ? forall [GroupHomomorphismSetting]:
        $is_normal_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
    claim:
        ? $is_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
        by thm homomorphism_maps_identity(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f) => f(one_A) = one_B
        by thm set_builder_member(one_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}) => one_A $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
        claim:
            ? forall kernel_x, kernel_y {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}:
                mul_A(kernel_x, kernel_y) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
            f(mul_A(kernel_x, kernel_y)) = mul_B(f(kernel_x), f(kernel_y)) = mul_B(one_B, one_B) = one_B
            by thm set_builder_member(mul_A(kernel_x, kernel_y), {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}) => mul_A(kernel_x, kernel_y) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
        claim:
            ? forall kernel_x {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}:
                inv_A(kernel_x) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
            by thm homomorphism_maps_inverse(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f, kernel_x) => f(inv_A(kernel_x)) = inv_B(f(kernel_x))
            by thm group_inverse_unique(B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, one_B, one_B) => inv_B(one_B) = one_B
            f(inv_A(kernel_x)) = inv_B(f(kernel_x)) = inv_B(one_B) = one_B
            by thm set_builder_member(inv_A(kernel_x), {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}) => inv_A(kernel_x) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
        by def $is_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
    claim:
        ? forall conjugator A, kernel_h {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}:
            mul_A(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h), inv_A(conjugator)) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
        f(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h)) = mul_B(f(conjugator), f(kernel_h))
        by thm homomorphism_maps_inverse(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f, conjugator) => f(inv_A(conjugator)) = inv_B(f(conjugator))
        mul_B(f(conjugator), one_B) = f(conjugator)
        f(mul_A(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h), inv_A(conjugator))) = mul_B(f(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h)), f(inv_A(conjugator))) = mul_B(mul_B(f(conjugator), f(kernel_h)), inv_B(f(conjugator))) = mul_B(mul_B(f(conjugator), one_B), inv_B(f(conjugator))) = mul_B(f(conjugator), inv_B(f(conjugator))) = one_B
        by thm set_builder_member(mul_A(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h), inv_A(conjugator)), {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}) => mul_A(mul_A(conjugator, kernel_h), inv_A(conjugator)) $in {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B}
    by def $is_normal_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
